sloka: अयोमुखः च गंतव्यः पर्वतो धातु मण्डितः ।विचित्र शिखरः श्रीमान् चित्र पुष्पित काननः ॥४-४१-१३॥
transliteration: ayomukhaḥ ca gaṁtavyaḥ parvato dhātu maṇḍitaḥ ।vicitra śikharaḥ śrīmān citra puṣpita kānanaḥ ॥4-41-13॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita all over mount Ayomukha (known as Malaya), rich in ores. It has wonderful peaks. It looks colourful with the forest in bloom. This great mountain is full of sandalwood forest.
